pages.text: Display Notches and Glow Display Notches can be altered from Item Frames and Glow Item Frames repsectively. These can be placed on any side of a block, and then an item can be inserted. Using dyes, the color of the notch can be changed, and using a pickaxe, the rotation of it alongside the displayed item. Interacting with an empty hand changes the elevation of the displayed item.
By placing them in a crafting grid, the Display Notches can be switched between Flat and Standing display mode. Adding a Glow Inc Sac to a Display Notch will also turn it into a Glow one.
